units.title: SG-6.1.1 Optional interaction field on the character schema
Act: Add optional interaction to characterSchema

tests.id: characterSchema.test.ts > characterSchema interaction > leaves interaction undefined when the character declares none
tests.name: leaves interaction undefined when the character declares none
tests.title: characterSchema interaction: leaves interaction undefined when the character declares none
tests.scenario: Given a character without an interaction block, When parsed, Then interaction is undefined
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: characterSchema.test.ts > characterSchema interaction > keeps the dialogue key when interaction declares a dialogue id
tests.name: keeps the dialogue key when interaction declares a dialogue id
tests.title: characterSchema interaction: keeps the dialogue key when interaction declares a dialogue id
tests.scenario: Given interaction dialogue 'npc-greeting', When parsed, Then interaction.dialogue is 'npc-greeting'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: characterSchema.test.ts > characterSchema interaction > keeps the actions list when interaction declares an action
tests.name: keeps the actions list when interaction declares an action
tests.title: characterSchema interaction: keeps the actions list when interaction declares an action
tests.scenario: Given an inspect action with label 'Talk', When parsed, Then exactly one action is kept with id 'inspect'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: characterSchema.test.ts > characterSchema rejects invalid interaction > throws when interaction dialogue is not a string
tests.name: throws when interaction dialogue is not a string
tests.title: characterSchema rejects invalid interaction: throws when interaction dialogue is not a string
tests.scenario: Given interaction dialogue 5, When parsed, Then parsing throws
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: characterSchema.test.ts > characterSchema rejects invalid interaction > throws when an interaction action uses an unknown action id
tests.name: throws when an interaction action uses an unknown action id
tests.title: characterSchema rejects invalid interaction: throws when an interaction action uses an unknown action id
tests.scenario: Given interaction action id 'dance', When parsed, Then parsing throws
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
